notes.title: Update 1.03 — Latin Spanish & Brazilian Portuguese Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Today’s update is especially close to our hearts — [i]Carnal Contract[/i] now includes [b]Latin American Spanish[/b] and [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]We know how passionate the gaming community is across Latin America and Brazil, and how much you’ve been asking for this. It was really important to us that you can fully experience the story in your own language, and we’re thrilled to finally deliver it.[/p][p][/p][p]From now on, you can switch to Spanish or Portuguese directly in the [b]settings menu[/b] and enjoy [i]Carnal Contract[/i] the way it was meant to be played.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Keep in mind, both Latin American Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese will go through one more proofreading round this week, so if you notice any mistakes, they will be fixed in the coming days.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]But we’re not stopping here. The [b]next language will be Russian[/b], which we expect to release in the [b]first week of October[/b]. After that, in October, we’ll announce which other language we’ll begin working on next. Step by step, we want [i]Carnal Contract[/i] to feel welcoming and accessible to players all around the world.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting us, for spreading the word, and for being part of this community. Every message we get from you motivates us to keep improving, and making [i]Carnal Contract[/i] better with every update.[/p][p][/p][p]— [b]Dotty Diaries[/b][/p][p][/p][p]

notes.title: Carnal Contract: Where Myth Becomes Reality
notes.content: [p]When you first step into [i]Carnal Contract[/i], it might feel like pure fantasy — a seductive game where the main character is trapped, forced to complete [b]lust-filled challenges[/b] delivered straight to his phone. But behind every forbidden temptation lies something far older than imagination.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860855/67edaa3afd88333e5c1679e26748f1428b32766f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]This story was born from an ancient civilization[/h2][p]Over 3,000 years ago, the [b]Minoans of Crete[/b] ruled the seas of the Aegean. They built palaces of impossible size, filled with frescoes of bulls, rituals, and goddesses. Their language, [b]Linear A[/b], remains undeciphered — a mystery frozen in clay. We do not know their true myths. We do not know their gods. All we know is what came after.[/p][p][/p][p]When the Minoans disappeared, the later Greeks told stories to explain their ruins. They spoke of [b]King Minos[/b], son of Zeus and Europa, who demanded tribute from Athens. Of his cursed queen [b]Pasiphaë[/b], whose unnatural desire birthed the monstrous [b]Minotaur[/b]. And of the [b]Labyrinth[/b] — a maze so vast and inescapable that no man could survive it without divine help.[/p][p][/p][p]In those myths, young men and women were sent inside [b]labyrinth [/b]as sacrifices. Some say they died. Others say they were forced into taboo ceremonies in front of the beast. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860855/741cdfdce02f1fd8b2ed5c7b8bd7f71724fd97d2.png"][/img][/p][h3]But what if the story never truly ended?[/h3][p]In [i]Carnal Contract[/i], we imagine a world where the cult of Minos never vanished. Where the “Minions of Crete” preserved their forbidden games in secret, passing them through generations. Their labyrinth has changed shape — no longer a palace of stone, but a web of control, power, and lust. Their monster no longer wears horns, but hides in the shadows of desire.[/p][p][/p][h3]And the sacrifices?[/h3][p]They are the ones, like you, who accept the contract.[/p][p][/p][p]Every [b]SMS challenge[/b] is a ritual reborn. Every task is a thread leading deeper into the labyrinth. And every choice you make decides whether you emerge free… or remain a prisoner of temptation, just as countless souls once were in Crete.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860855/b7af489b5544715996c0d323cf4cc23cd506a49b.png"][/img][/p][p]This is not just a story of fantasy. It is the [b]rebirth of ancient myth[/b], retold in our time.  Step inside and explore the secrets of the Minions! [/p][p]-Dotty[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484170/Carnal_Contract/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://discord.com/invite/52JuSBvd5t"]Join our Discord community[/url] to unlock special content: exclusive renders, custom-made artwork, wallpapers, and images you won’t find anywhere else.[/p]

notes.title: Carnal Contract Now Available in French & Simplified Chinese!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [i]Carnal Contract[/i] just got even more accessible - we’ve added [b]Simplified[/b] [b]Chinese[/b] and [b]French[/b] language support to the game! [/p][p][/p][p]This is something many of you have been asking for, and we’re really happy to finally bring it to you. [/p][p][/p][p]Whether you want to enjoy the story in your native language or simply prefer playing in another one, you can now switch to Chinese or French directly from the settings menu.[/p][p][/p][p]But that’s not all - [b]Spanish and Russian[/b] translations are also in the works and will be coming very soon. [/p][p][/p][p]We expect to have them be released in [b]September[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]If you spot any mistakes or have suggestions for the Chinese or French translations, please let us know on our Discord -> [url="https://discord.com/invite/52JuSBvd5t"]HERE[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860855/11de3eea346041367f155e54c29011c09ba0d614.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who supported us and gave feedback along the way. Your encouragement is what keeps us going and helps us make [i]Carnal Contract[/i] better with every update.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates (and some spicy new content down the road 😉).[/p][p]— Dotty Diaries[/p]

notes.title: Carnal Contract is Live on Steam!
notes.content:
[p]After years of hard work, we’re beyond excited to announce that [i]Carnal Contract[/i] is finally out on Steam![/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who’s been here on this journey, and to everyone who has bought (or will buy) the game, or even just shared it with friends. Your support means a lot.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484170/Carnal_Contract/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]TRANSLATIONS STATUS[/b][/p][p]Many of you have asked about translations, so here’s the update.[/p][p]We’re actively working on [b]Spanish, Russian, French, [/b]and[b] Simplified Chinese[/b]. Spanish is nearly finished, and we’ve now started French and Simplified Chinese alongside Russian.[/p][p]I can’t promise whether they’ll be done in just a few days or a few weeks but they’ll definitely be released during [b]September[/b]. As soon as one is ready, it’ll be pushed out in an update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b][/p][p]Right now, there are [b]40 achievements[/b] for you to collect.[/p][p]With the next update, we’ll be adding [b]20 more[/b], these won’t be as easy. You’ll need to put in some extra effort to unlock them![/p][p]We’ve already finished 10 of them, with 10 more on the way. Expect them to go live early next week.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BUG REPORT[/b][/p][p]If you encounter any bugs, please hop into our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F52JuSBvd5t"]Discord[/url] and let us know. We tested as much as possible, but we’re sure a few sneaky issues slipped through. Your reports help us fix them quickly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BUNDLE - PLAYING WITH FIRE[/b][/p][p]Don’t miss out on our [b]bundle[/b] with the fantastic game [i]Between Two Worlds[/i]! If you’re interested in both, you can grab them together at a discount.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58569/Playing_With_Fire/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Once again, thank you so much for playing, for supporting, and for being part of this journey. Don’t forget to leave a review on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]See you in the next update!
— [i]Dotty[/i][/p]

notes.title: 8 Days Until Release – The Final Countdown!
notes.content: [p]We’ve hit [b]18,200 wishlists[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for all the support so far. A strong wishlist count helps us tremendously at launch, so if you haven’t yet, please consider adding the game to your wishlist and sharing it with friends. Every single one makes a difference![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2484170/extras/2f8b3e56496d63ace81a6681f80c8fd9.avif?t=1755024566"][/img][/p][h3][b]Translations[/b][/h3][p]We’re currently working hard on [b]Spanish[/b] and [b]Russian[/b] translations. If you’d like to see the game in your language, [b]drop a comment or start a discussion[/b] to let us know which one should be next![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Proofreading[/b][/h3][p]The entire script is going through a [b]final proofreading pass[/b] to make sure everything reads smoothly and any small errors are fixed before launch. This is part of our last quality push so the story feels as polished as possible on day one.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Walkthrough[/b][/h3][p]Since the game features [b]multiple love interests[/b] and choices that can change the story, we’re also preparing a [b]walkthrough[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]The countdown is officially on… just over a week to go before we open the doors.[/p][p][/p][p]p.s. [url="https://discord.com/invite/52JuSBvd5t"]Join us on Discord![/url][/p]

notes.title: Carnal Contract - Engaging Visual Novel
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484170/Carnal_Contract/


[h1]Carnal Contract - Short Description[/h1]

Carnal Contract is an adult Visual Novel in which you take control of a young man who got stuck in major debts. A strange game provides a way out, but only if he dares to complete carnal challenges. The game is filled with sex, mystery, different challenges and drama.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/fvJsv44/e8i1157.webp[/img]

[h1]What Awaits You?[/h1]

- Over 8,500 images.
- 250+ animated scenes.
- 5-10 hours gameplay.
- Diverse adult content.
- Gorgeous character interactions.
- Mysterious story.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0GNC5R/e5i413.webp[/img]


[h1]When the Game Will be Available?[/h1]

We have created over 8500 images, both designed and rendered. Currently, we're adding additional scenes to fill gaps in the story.

Initially, the plan was to release the game after completing 8500 renders, but over 10.000 people played it during the development phase and provided feedback that I couldn't ignore.

Now, we're planning to create an additional 1500-2000 renders before launching on STEAM to complete the story.

For the last 16 months, I have been working on this game full-time, dedicating all my effort to ensure it's an amazing experience for everyone who plays it.

It's not just about the graphics; it's about the experience and the feelings you get while playing.

I'll post updates here every few weeks to keep you informed and excited about Carnal Contract.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/nwHMgSW/e3i216-f-6.webp[/img]

[h1]Thank You![/h1]

If you find yourself enjoying the work I've put into creating this game and wish to express your support, kindly consider adding it to your wishlist.

I extend my deepest gratitude for taking the time to visit my page and for your generous appreciation.

Warm regards,

Dotty
